'''Gil's Hat''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that can be obtained as a reward for going into the [[Skull Cavern]] during the [[Desert Festival]]. It is received from [[Gil]] the first time an [[Desert Festival#Skull Cavern|egg rating]] of 25-54 is submitted. This hat can be obtained only once per save file, or once per player in [[Multiplayer]].

If the original is lost, a replacement can be purchased at the [[Secret Woods#Lost Items Shop|Lost Items Shop]] in the Secret Woods for {{Price|10000}}.
